description: Describe cron expressions and compute upcoming run times. Operations: "describe" — Produce a human-readable description of a cron expression.; "next-runs" — Compute the next N run times for a cron expression.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant). Not repeatable: next-runs returns a different result on each call.

input.description: describe: A 5- or 6-field cron expression. next-runs: A 5- or 6-field cron expression.

operation.description: describe — Produce a human-readable description of a cron expression. next-runs — Compute the next N run times for a cron expression.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

count.description: How many runs to return. Used by: next-runs.

name: cron
title: Cron Expression Parser
